description: This Java class 'TraceUtils' provides utility methods for tracing HTTP and AMQP requests, generating timers with specific tags for metrics collection, and handling trace information and URI formatting.

classes.name: TraceUtils
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing timers for tracing HTTP and AMQP requests, including URI and command tagging, and trace information determination.

methods.name: newHttpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer builder for HTTP roundtrip metrics, extracting request method and trace tags.

methods.name: newAmqpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer builder for AMQP roundtrip metrics based on command or signal.

methods.name: newAuthFilterTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer builder for authentication filter metrics, with optional request context.

methods.name: metricizeTraceUri
methods.description: Sanitizes trace URI strings for metric compatibility by replacing invalid characters.
